name: resend_send_email
description: Send a transactional email via Resend. Supports HTML, plain text, CC, BCC, and scheduled sending.

name: resend_get_email
description: Get the status and details of a sent email by its ID

name: resend_update_email
description: Reschedule a scheduled email to a new send time

name: resend_cancel_scheduled_email
description: Cancel a scheduled email before it sends

name: resend_send_batch_emails
description: Send multiple emails in a single API call with Resend batch sending

emails.description: Array of email objects with from, to, subject, html/text

name: resend_list_domains
description: List all sending domains configured in the Resend account

name: resend_get_domain
description: Get the DNS records and verification status for a Resend sending domain

name: resend_create_domain
description: Add a new sending domain to Resend

name: resend_verify_domain
description: Trigger DNS verification for a Resend domain after adding DNS records

name: resend_update_domain
description: Update tracking settings (open tracking, click tracking) for a Resend domain

name: resend_delete_domain
description: Remove a sending domain from the Resend account

name: resend_list_api_keys
description: List all API keys in the Resend account

name: resend_create_api_key
description: Create a new API key for Resend with optional domain restrictions

name: resend_delete_api_key
description: Delete a Resend API key

name: resend_list_audiences
description: List all email audiences (lists) in the Resend account

name: resend_create_audience
description: Create a new email audience/list in Resend for managing contact groups

name: resend_get_audience
description: Get details about a specific Resend audience

name: resend_delete_audience
description: Delete a Resend audience/list

name: resend_list_contacts
description: List all contacts in a Resend audience

name: resend_create_contact
description: Add a new contact to a Resend audience

name: resend_get_contact
description: Get a specific contact from a Resend audience

name: resend_update_contact
description: Update a contact in a Resend audience — change name, subscription status, etc.

name: resend_delete_contact
description: Remove a contact from a Resend audience
